RECOMMENDATION: DON'T RAISE IT
LIKELIHOOD: 0

Both you and the successful candidate are men, meaning your sex was not a disadvantage relative to the person selected. While an all-male panel may reflect broader representation issues within the bank's leadership, it provides no basis for a claim of sex discrimination in choosing between two male applicants. Raising the panel's gender composition would appear unfounded and could damage your professional reputation. 

The decision likely came down to profile fit: the panel prioritized regulatory affairs over deeper statistical modelling. Rather than mentioning the panel's demographics, send a polite follow-up requesting constructive feedback on how your experience aligned with the role's strategic requirements.
